name: TextField
summary: One line of text saved on its own when the person leaves the field (blur-commit), at seven sizes, with an optional leading icon, fixed prefix or suffix text, a Clear button, a character count and a hidden-text (password) form. Not for values that must be valid or saved together with others (put those in a form with a Save button), or for long text that autosaves while typing.
a11y: A native `input` named by its visible `label` (with "(optional)" when marked), the prefix and suffix joined to the name; the hint, count, error and any failure are linked with `aria-describedby`. Pending takes the commit colour and a spinner in the trailing slot; the same focused input stays, read-only with `aria-disabled` and `aria-busy`, so focus never moves. Confirmed shows a tick and announces "Saved" politely. A failure keeps the person's text, marks the field invalid and offers Retry and Revert. A validation `error` marks it invalid with the message below. Read-only stays focusable. Clear and Show are named buttons after the input in the tab order. Targets: 44 px and up from `normal`; `xs` and `s` are dense exceptions. In `mode="form"` (IP14) it is one field of a form: no save of its own, no states or "Saved" on the field, Enter submits the form. Every word it shows or says can be given in `words`.

keys.action: saves the value now (in a form: submits the form)
puts back the stored value (not in a form)

props.name: label
props.description: A noun phrase naming what goes in, with no colon: "Project name".

props.name: value
props.description: The stored value (`commit`), or the form's current value (`form`).

props.name: mode
props.description: `commit` (default): saved on its own when the person leaves the field or presses Enter, with pending, saved and failed states on the field. `form` (IP14): one field of a form saved together with one Save button: nothing saves on blur or Enter, no state or "Saved" shows on the field, and Enter submits the form; the form owns the value (`onChange`) and its errors (`error`, and an ErrorSummary).

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Stores the new value when the person leaves the field or presses Enter (`commit` mode, where it's needed). Return a promise for a save; reject it when the save fails.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Runs on every change while the person types (IP14), e.g. to narrow a list as they type. In `form` mode, store it and pass it back as `value`.

props.name: name
props.description: The input's `name`, for a form that reads its fields by name.

props.name: words
props.description: The words the field shows and says, over the English defaults (IP14): its saved announcement, a failed save's buttons, Clear, Show and Hide, a removable chip's button and a code's length.

props.name: hint
props.description: One short sentence: the format, why it's asked, or what happens.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: An example value, never the label or an instruction.

props.name: type
props.description: The kind of text, for the keyboard and autofill. `password` hides the text and adds a Show button; `code` is a one-time code drawn as one cell per character (`length`).

props.name: size
props.description: The Button size scale: the box is xs 24, s 36, normal 44 (default), m 48, l 56, xl 64 or xxl 80 px high. The label and hint keep their size.

props.name: icon
props.description: A leading icon that says what kind of value it is (search, email). Decorative: the label names the field.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Short fixed text before the value, inside the box, such as "https://" or "£". Read with the label.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Short fixed text after the value, inside the box, such as "kg" or ".com". Read with the label.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a Clear button while there's text; clearing saves the empty value like any other change.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The most characters allowed; a count shows under the box and is announced as the limit nears.

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "(optional)". Fields are required by default, so only optional ones are marked.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the value without letting it change, e.g. an ID; still focusable and copyable.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The value can't change here and needn't be read. Prefer `readOnly`, or say why in the hint.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong with the value and how to fix it, shown under the box until the value is fixed. Marks the field invalid.

props.name: failedText
props.description: What happened and what was kept, when a save fails. Defaults to naming the field.

props.name: inputMode
props.description: The on-screen keyboard to offer: `numeric` for digits, `decimal`, `email`, `url`, `tel`, `search`. Defaults from `type`.

props.name: prefixMenu
props.description: A choice attached before the box that sets part of the value, such as a country's dialling code. The button shows the chosen item's `short` text.

props.name: action
props.description: A button attached after the box that acts on the value, such as Search or Send. Enter presses it too.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: One key that moves focus here from anywhere on the page, shown in the box while it's empty and not focused, e.g. "/".

props.name: chip
props.description: A removable chip at the start of the box that narrows what the value applies to, e.g. a search scope "In: Tokens". Backspace at the start removes it too.

props.name: length
props.description: With `type="code"`: how many characters the code has (4 to 8). The field saves as soon as the code is complete.

props.name: group
props.description: With `type="code"`: characters per group, drawn with a wider gap between groups ("123 456" is `group={3}`). The value never contains a separator.

props.name: masked
props.description: With `type="code"`: draws each typed character as a dot, for a PIN someone nearby shouldn't read. Off for one-time codes, which expire.

props.name: swatch
props.description: A colour swatch at the start of the box that opens the ColourPicker in a popover (as ColourField does), for a hex value.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the visible label where the row already says what it is (an inspector). It still names the field.

props.name: saved
props.description: Announced once a save is stored: "Saved".

props.name: retry
props.description: A failed save's buttons: "Retry" and "Revert".

props.name: clear
props.description: The Clear button's name: "Clear {label}".

props.name: show
props.description: The password field's button: "Show" and "Hide".

props.name: removeChip
props.description: A chip's remove button: "Remove {chip}".

props.name: digits
props.description: Said after a code's length: "digits" for a numeric code, else "characters".

props.name: label
props.description: Names the choice for assistive technology, e.g. "Country code".

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen item's `value`.

props.name: items
props.description: Each choice: `label` in the open list ("India +91"), `short` on the button ("+91"), and `flag`, the country's flag drawn before both (an SVG, the same on every system; without it the code alone shows).

props.name: label
props.description: A verb: "Search", "Send". The accessible name when `iconOnly`.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Shows only the icon; `label` names it and shows as its tooltip.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: `primary` when it's the view's main action; `default` (outlined) otherwise.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Receives the text in the box.
